name: sirdadfar/iran-accounting-connector
description: Framework for pushing shop invoices, payments and customers into Iranian accounting software with mapping, idempotency, retries and dry-run support.

suggest.ext-curl: Required by Http\CurlClient (the default HTTP transport).
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Useful for a single-file durable idempotency store.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Useful when the idempotency store lives in MySQL.
